self_critique:
The shot is much closer to a dopamine toy set. The walls are true mint and pistachio, the pedestal is coral, the orb glows like S01's, and the room enters bright, matching S01's brightness at the cut. It also exits as a bright pastel ball that matches S03. The critical blotch boiling is gone: the lemon halo is now quieter than the clean floor, at 1536 spp with adaptive sampling off. The cost is about 1.5 GPU-h, inside the cap, after I found that shadow linking alone cost 34-41%.

The motion problems the critic listed are fixed: the orb slam, the heart passing in front of the orb, the ring's impact hidden on the cut frame, the pan-then-dolly push, and the void showing during the push. Each beat now has an event (clicks on f76/f91/f106, a landing on f136, the aim settling on f166).

What is still weak, bluntly:
- The heart caustic does not read as a heart with bright rims. It is the weakest of the four proofs.
- The bunny's rainbow is subtle, and moving the bunny toward the pool made the macro's top-left corner busier (cropped bunny and plinth).
- The lemon still carries a refraction line in the macro and reads amber in the wides.
- The floor is cream near the orb but drifts to beige toward the back-right. By the critic's metric the macro is still about 50% grey-mid, although by eye it reads warm cream with lilac shadows.

I spent too long reasoning about layout geometry for the lemon and bunny before testing. A quick visual A/B, like the plinth-hide test that settled the lemon question, earlier would have left time to try the chamfered heart.

rejected_critic_items: Heart rebuild as a chamfered flat plate (major). Not adopted. The helper is built and available via S02_HEART=chamfer, but there was no time for an A/B. Physics argument: the orb's ~6 deg angular size blurs any rim or chamfer caustic at the heart's ~0.3 m throw to the floor by ~3 cm. That is the same as the 2.5-3 cm chamfer width, so a crisp bright rim line is unlikely. The pink glass also passes only ~27% luminance, so the 1.3x-open-floor rim target is not reachable without focusing. Pink absorb 2.0 -> 1.0 was applied.

Heart tilt back 10 -> 25-30 deg (part of the heart item). Rejected: the floor-projection depth per unit heart height is sin(tau) - cot(theta_light) cos(tau). With the orb at ~48 deg elevation, tilting back shortens the projection (0.71 -> ~0.33 of the heart height) and makes the caustic band flatter, not taller.

Pool peak 0.65-0.70 via key ~18 W (part of the grey-mud item). Not followed: lead S02-1/G2 want the floor to read pastel and allow an exposure lift. The pool sits at ~0.85 display, caustic peaks stay at or below 0.964.
Macro reframe to 65 mm (alternative in the framing item). Kept 75 mm per lead S02-5; used the critic's other option (pull back 0.4 m at 75 mm, shift 0.12 m left, target 5 cm lower).
Orb drop to z 0.80 in the macro (optional). Used 0.83 (3 x 4 cm); a lower or wider arc puts the orb over the bunny's ears.
Blend the push target with ease_in_cubic over f140-165 (minor). Used a smootherstep pre-aim f136-166 with a detent settle instead: it has no speed discontinuity at f165.
Glossy-only blush kicker card for glass in flight (minor, optional). Not added; the brighter walls carry it.
Heart rim minimum curvature 3 mm (minor). Not done; the puffy heart is kept.
